title: Isogenic human neural stem cell model to study glioblastoma-associated mutations and INSM1-linked neuronal progenitor programs
keywords: isogenic human neural stem cell model
core_idea: Develop an isogenic human neural stem cell model by sequentially introducing TERT promoter, TP53, and PDGFRA mutations to investigate how canonical glioblastoma mutations drive tumor cell–intrinsic functional plasticity and interact with developmental transcriptional programs (including INSM1), and to probe associated stress-related metabolic changes and potential shifts toward neuronal progenitor states.
tldr: Build a sequentially mutated human NSC model to study how glioblastoma driver mutations promote cellular plasticity and engage developmental programs such as INSM1.
